title: Lift Scans Standing on a Granite Ridge Pass Account and the Share Taken of the Gross Amount
content:
The lift scan entries a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme pass account shows reduce the share at which the gross amount coming back is taken. The points below set out the share.

*What share is taken where the pass account shows at least 6 lift scan entries?* Nine tenths of the gross amount, a share of 90 per cent.

*And where it shows at least 1 lift scan entry but fewer than 6?* Nineteen twentieths of the gross amount, a share of 95 per cent.

*And in any other case?* The gross amount is not reduced by this rule.

*Does the share fall further on an account showing many scans?* No. At 6 entries the share is 90 per cent and it does not fall further however far above 6 the count runs. At 5 entries it is 95 per cent, and at none the gross amount is not reduced by this rule.

*What is counted?* Lift scan entries standing on that pass account.

*Worked on hypothetical figures.* A gross amount of 900.00 on a pass account showing 8 lift scan entries is taken at 90 per cent, which gives 810.00. The same gross amount on an account showing 4 entries is taken at 95 per cent, which gives 855.00.
